about.text: A soft, fresh, mildly sweet and slightly buttery cheese from the Tuscan-Romagnol Apennines. Rennet is added and the curd is drained unbroken in baskets, or wrapped in fern, fig or cabbage leaves. It was traditionally made from raw milk, now usually pasteurised, and is eaten within a few days.
